PROJECT / 04 — Full-stack platform

SkillSwap

A peer-to-peer learning platform where people exchange what they know instead of paying for lessons.

View source on GitHub ↗
Focus
Full-stack platform
Stack
React · Node.js · MySQL · WebSockets
Format
Project case study
The work

From problem to system.

The problem

Learning often depends on finding someone who has the skill you need. SkillSwap frames teaching as an exchange between peers, with profiles and listings to make that match possible.

The approach

The project separates a React frontend from a Node.js backend, stores platform data in MySQL, and uses WebSockets for real-time interactions. Its repository documents profiles, skill listings, and the local setup.

01
Create a presence

Users can present their skills through profiles and listings.

02
Discover a match

People look for a skill they want to learn and offer their own knowledge in return.

03
Interact in real time

WebSocket-based interactions support the exchange.

The public README provides a high-level feature and stack overview. It does not document deployment, usage numbers, or measured outcomes, so this case study stays within that scope.
